'''Taki-no-o Shrine''' (瀧尾神社, 滝尾神社) refers to Shinto shrines across Japan. As of now, there are 13 shrines registered under the old-style kanji 瀧尾神社, 4 under the new-style kanji 滝尾神社, and 1 shrine incorporating the name 瀧尾神社 in its title.

* {{ill|Taki-no-o Shrine (Yachiyo, Ibaraki)|ja|瀧尾神社 (八千代町)}} - Located in Awa, Yachiyo, Yūki District, Ibaraki Prefecture.
* {{ill|Taki-no-o Shrine (Utsunomiya, Ezoshima)|ja|瀧尾神社 (宇都宮市江曽島)}} - Located in Ezoshima, Utsunomiya City, Tochigi Prefecture.
* {{ill|Taki-no-o Shrine (Utsunomiya, Takidanicho)|ja|瀧尾神社 (宇都宮市滝谷町)}} - Located in Takidanicho, Utsunomiya City, Tochigi Prefecture.
* {{ill|Taki-no-o Shrine (Utsunomiya, Hiratsukacho)|ja|瀧尾神社 (宇都宮市平塚町)}} - Located in Hiratsukacho, Utsunomiya City, Tochigi Prefecture.
* {{ill|Nikkō Taki-no-o Shrine (Kanuma)|ja|日光瀧尾神社}} - Located in Kuchi Awa, Kanuma City, Tochigi Prefecture.
* {{ill|Taki-no-o Shrine (Nikkō, Imaichi)|ja|瀧尾神社 (日光市今市)}} (Imaichi Taki-no-o Shrine) - Located in Imaichi, Nikkō City, Tochigi Prefecture. Main shrine of Imaichi.
* {{ill|Taki-no-o Shrine (Nikkō, Kawamata)|ja|瀧尾神社 (日光市川俣)}} - Located in Kawamata, Nikkō City, Tochigi Prefecture.
* {{ill|Taki-no-o Shrine (Nikkō, Kiwadashima)|ja|瀧尾神社 (日光市木和田島)}} - Located in Kiwadashima, Nikkō City, Tochigi Prefecture.
* {{ill|Taki-no-o Shrine (Nikkō, Kuragasaki)|ja|瀧尾神社 (日光市倉ケ崎)}} - Located in Kuragasaki, Nikkō City, Tochigi Prefecture.
* {{ill|Taki-no-o Shrine (Nikkō, Kosagoe)|ja|瀧尾神社 (日光市小佐越)}} - Located in Kosagoe, Nikkō City, Tochigi Prefecture.
* {{ill|Taki-no-o Shrine (Nikkō, Kobayashi)|ja|瀧尾神社 (日光市小林)}} - Located in Kobayashi, Nikkō City, Tochigi Prefecture.
* {{ill|Taki-no-o Shrine (Nikkō, Seo)|ja|滝尾神社 (日光市瀬尾)}} - Located in Seo, Nikkō City, Tochigi Prefecture.
* {{ill|Taki-no-o Shrine (Nikkō, Torobu)|ja|滝尾神社 (日光市土呂部)}} - Located in Torobu, Nikkō City, Tochigi Prefecture.
* {{ill|Taki-no-o Shrine (Nikkō, Moritomo)|ja|瀧尾神社 (日光市森友)}} - Located in Moritomo, Nikkō City, Tochigi Prefecture.
* {{ill|Taki-no-o Shrine (Nikkō, Yamaguchi)|ja|瀧尾神社 (日光市山口)}} - Located in Yamaguchi, Nikkō City, Tochigi Prefecture.
* {{ill|Takio Shrine|ja|瀧尾神社|qid=Q85882196}} - Located in Sannai, Nikkō City, Tochigi Prefecture. A detached shrine of {{ill|Futarasan shrine|ar|ضريح فوتاراسان|az|Futarasan məbədi|ca|Santuari Futarasan|cs|Svatyně Futarasan|de|Nikkō-Futarasan-Schrein|es|Santuario Futarasan|fa|معبد فوتاراسان|fr|Futarasan-jinja|id|Kuil Futarasan|ja|日光二荒山神社|ko|닛코 후타라산 신사|nl|Futarasan-schrijn|pl|Futarasan-jinja|pt|Futarasan jinja|th|ศาลเจ้านิกโกฟูตาราซัง|tr|Futarasan tapınağı|zh|日光二荒山神社|qid=Q701927|lt=Nikkō Futarasan Shrine}}, guarding Mount Nyohō.
* {{ill|Takio Shrine|ja|瀧尾神社|qid=Q85882196}} - Located at the eighth station of {{ill|Mount Nantai|ar|جبل نانتاي|arz|جبل مونت نانتاى|ceb|Nantai San|cs|Nantaisan|de|Nantai (Vulkan)|es|Monte Nantai|eu|Nantai mendia|fa|کوه نانتای|fr|Mont Nantai|gl|Monte Nantai|id|Gunung Nantai|ja|男体山|ka|ნანტაის მთა|my|နန်းတိုင်းတောင်|pnb|ٹلہ نانٹائ|pt|Monte Nantai|ru|Нантай|sk|Nantai|tr|Nantai Dağı|uz|Nantai togʻi|vi|Núi Nantai|zh|男體山|qid=Q1964765|lt=Mount Nantai}}, Nikkō City, Tochigi Prefecture.
